copy.landing.intro.0.heading: Why in Malayalam?
copy.landing.intro.0.paras.0: Seeing Vishukkani and hearing the year's forecast, comparing horoscopes before a marriage proposal, fixing a muhurtham for a housewarming — astrology is part of life in Malayali homes. These Malayalam pages exist so that information comes accurately, in our own language.
copy.landing.intro.0.paras.1: No result here is copied from anywhere. We compute where the nine planets really are that day (Lahiri ayanamsa) and read them by the traditional methods of Chandrabalam, Tarabalam and gochara. Anyone looking at the same date gets the same result.
copy.landing.intro.1.heading: What is here?
copy.landing.intro.1.paras.0: Today's rashifal shows clearly which house the Moon is in from your koor, whether today is Chandrashtama, and whether Ezharasani, Kandakasani or Ashtamasani is running. The Rashifal 2027 pages show on which dates Jupiter, Saturn and Rahu–Ketu change signs, and how each month looks.
copy.landing.intro.1.paras.1: The panchang gives tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, weekday, sunrise/sunset, Rahu kalam, Yamakandam, Gulika kalam and Amrita kalam — all by your city's sunrise. Matching gives the ten poruthams, Papasamyam and Chovva dosham in detail, plus the 36-guna matching for comparison.
copy.landing.intro.2.heading: About remedies
copy.landing.intro.2.paras.0: Astrology is not meant to frighten. When transits are unfavourable we first suggest no-cost ways — chanting, vratham, giving, temple visits. BornClock sells no pooja or gemstone. These are suggestions about habits, not guaranteed predictions.
copy.landing.faq.0.q: How do I find my koor and nakshatra (naal)?
copy.landing.faq.0.a: Koor is the sign the Moon was in at birth; naal is the nakshatra. Enter birth date, time and place in BornClock's free horoscope and you get both at once.
copy.landing.faq.1.q: Do the rashifal and panchang change every day?
copy.landing.faq.1.a: Yes. Just after midnight Indian time the result and panchang change automatically to the new day's planetary positions.
copy.landing.faq.2.a: Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa, drik (observational) method. Many Kerala panchangams follow the same or a very similar method.
copy.landing.faq.3.q: Will the result here definitely happen?
copy.landing.faq.3.a: The planetary positions and times are computed accurately; the way they are read is traditional. This is guidance showing tendencies, not a certainty.
copy.landing.faq.4.q: Do I need to spend money on remedies?
copy.landing.faq.4.a: No. We first suggest no-cost ways like chanting, vratham and giving. No remedy is compulsory; BornClock sells nothing.
copy.rashifal.hubLead: Choose your koor and read today's result. Each koor's result is computed separately from that day's planetary movements.
copy.rashifal.intro.0.heading: How is the result read from the koor?
copy.rashifal.intro.0.paras.0: In Kerala the daily result is read from the koor — the sign the Moon was in at birth (e.g. Ashwathi, Bharani, Karthika first quarter = Medakkoor; rest of Karthika, Rohini, first half of Makayiram = Edavakkoor). Which house today's transiting Moon is in from your koor mainly sets the day's mood and situations. Moon strength is good in houses 1, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11; the 8th house is Chandrashtama.
copy.rashifal.intro.0.paras.1: Tarabalam is also checked: counting in nines from the birth star to today's star gives the taras Janma, Sampat, Vipat, Kshema…; tradition says take care on the 3rd, 5th and 7th taras. Since a koor has two or three nakshatras, each nakshatra is given separately.
copy.rashifal.intro.1.heading: Saturn and Jupiter — the long-term background
copy.rashifal.intro.1.paras.0: The Moon changes sign every two and a quarter days; Saturn stays about two and a half years in a sign and Jupiter about a year. So Ezharasani, Kandakasani and Ashtamasani are always mentioned as the background of the daily result. Ezharasani is not a time to fear — it builds responsibility and maturity and gives lasting results for hard work.
copy.rashifal.intro.1.paras.1: Each section also uses which house Venus (love and marriage), Mercury (work, documents, trade) and Mars (energy and speed) are in from your koor.
copy.rashifal.intro.2.heading: Good time and Rahu kalam
copy.rashifal.intro.2.paras.0: Each rashifal gives the day's good time (Choghadiya method, avoiding Rahu kalam) and Rahu kalam by Delhi time. For exact times in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram see our Malayalam panchang page — there every time follows your city's sunrise.
copy.rashifal.faq.0.q: Should rashifal be read by koor or by lagnam?
copy.rashifal.faq.0.a: The daily result is read by koor (Moon sign), not the Sun sign of English horoscopes. Lagnam is for the personal horoscope.
copy.rashifal.faq.1.q: What should not be done on a Chandrashtama day?
copy.rashifal.faq.1.a: Traditionally, big investments, new contracts and important negotiations are postponed and arguments avoided. Nothing to fear — just a little restraint for two days a month.
copy.rashifal.faq.2.a: The 'Why?' section of each rashifal says, from Saturn's actual position that day, whether Ezharasani, Kandakasani or Ashtamasani applies. For full dates see the Rashifal 2027 page.
copy.rashifal.faq.3.q: Do all people of the same koor get the same result?
copy.rashifal.faq.3.a: The daily result is common to a koor. Your own dasha-apahara and lagnam change the experience; for that the full horoscope is needed.
copy.rashifal.faq.4.a: Just after 12 midnight Indian time the new day's result appears automatically on this same page.
copy.year.intro.0.heading: 2027 — a year of planetary changes
copy.year.intro.0.paras.0: How a year goes is set mainly by the slow planets — Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu–Ketu. When hearing the Vishu forecast everyone first asks 'Is Jupiter favourable for our koor, where is Saturn?'. These pages find by astronomical calculation on which date each planet moves into which sign in 2027, and read the result from which house that is from your koor.
copy.year.intro.0.paras.1: For each koor the day-by-day score for the whole year is taken, and from it the best period, the period needing care and the monthly results. So the pages of the twelve koors are different — not cast in one mould.
copy.year.intro.1.heading: Ezharasani, Kandakasani, Ashtamasani, eclipses
copy.year.intro.1.paras.0: Ezharasani is when Saturn is in the 12th, 1st and 2nd houses from your koor; Kandakasani in the 4th, Ashtamasani in the 8th. Each page gives which of these applies to your koor in 2027, from which date to which date.
copy.year.intro.1.paras.1: Dates and times (IST) of the 2027 solar and lunar eclipses, and which house from your koor they fall in, are included. On an eclipse day: calm chanting, then giving — that is our way.
copy.year.intro.2.heading: Remedies — no-cost first
copy.year.intro.2.paras.0: Everything we suggest for unfavourable transits is optional: chanting, vratham, giving, temple visits. Nothing is compulsory, nothing guarantees results. For big decisions like a wedding date, fix the muhurtham from both full horoscopes; here only favourable periods are shown.
copy.year.faq.0.q: When are the 2027 Jupiter and Saturn changes?
copy.year.faq.0.a: The 'Main planetary changes in 2027' table on each koor's page gives the exact dates Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu change signs, from real astronomical calculation.
copy.year.faq.1.a: Ezharasani is for the koors before, at and after the sign Saturn is in. See it with dates in the 'Ezharasani, Kandakasani' section of your koor's 2027 page.
copy.year.faq.2.q: Is the yearly result by koor or by lagnam?
copy.year.faq.2.a: Here by koor (Moon sign) — the traditional way of reading transits. To read lagnam and dasha together you need the full horoscope.
copy.year.faq.3.q: Which period in 2027 is good for marriage?
copy.year.faq.3.a: Each koor's page gives periods when Venus or Jupiter favour the marriage houses. Decide the final muhurtham from both horoscopes.
copy.year.faq.4.q: How reliable is this yearly result?
copy.year.faq.4.a: The dates of the planetary changes are computed accurately; their effects follow traditional transit rules. This is guidance for planning, not a guaranteed prediction.
copy.panchang.intro.0.heading: Panchang — five limbs
copy.panchang.intro.0.paras.0: Tithi, weekday, nakshatra, yoga, karana — these five make the panchang. For any auspicious event — marriage, choroonu (first feeding), housewarming, new vehicle — Malayali homes first check the panchang and Rahu kalam. This page gives the same daily, with your city's times.
copy.panchang.intro.0.paras.1: Each 12 degrees between Sun and Moon is one tithi. From new moon to full moon is Shukla paksha (bright fortnight), full moon to new moon Krishna paksha (dark fortnight). The nakshatra (naal) is one of 27 parts the Moon is in; yoga comes from the sum of Sun and Moon positions; a karana is half a tithi.
copy.panchang.intro.1.heading: Rahu kalam, Gulika kalam, Yamakandam
copy.panchang.intro.1.paras.0: The daytime from the city's sunrise to sunset is split into eight equal parts; by weekday one part is Rahu kalam, one Yamakandam, one Gulika kalam. So Rahu kalam differs by a few minutes between Kochi and Thiruvananthapuram. Only starting new things is avoided in these times; work already going on need not stop.
copy.panchang.intro.1.paras.1: For good times, Brahma muhurtham, Abhijit muhurtham, Amrita kalam and day/night Choghadiyas are also given. Abhijit muhurtham is not taken on Wednesday.
copy.panchang.intro.2.heading: How is it computed?
copy.panchang.intro.2.paras.0: From each city's latitude and longitude, BornClock's own engine computes that day's real sunrise/sunset and the sidereal Sun and Moon positions (Lahiri ayanamsa). All times in IST, to the nearest minute. Clock time is given here instead of Kerala's traditional nazhika–vinazhika count.
copy.kundali.intro.0.heading: Ten poruthams and Papasamyam
copy.kundali.intro.0.paras.0: In Kerala the first thing checked in a marriage proposal is horoscope matching — the ten poruthams Dina, Gana, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rasi, Rasyadhipa, Vasya, Rajju, Vedha, plus Papasamyam. The poruthams come from both people's birth nakshatra and koor; Papasamyam from the planetary chart.
copy.kundali.intro.0.paras.1: Just enter both people's birth date, time and place — we compute nakshatra, koor and chart (Lahiri), show each porutham as 'yes / no' with the reason, and Papasamyam with both people's papa totals.
copy.kundali.intro.1.heading: What is Papasamyam?
copy.kundali.intro.1.paras.0: Mars, Saturn, Sun and Rahu are treated as malefics. Papa is counted when they are in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12 from Lagna, Moon and Venus — 1 from Lagna, ½ from Moon, ¼ from Venus. Comparing totals, Papasamyam is said to exist when the girl's is not higher than the boy's.
copy.kundali.intro.1.paras.1: Many astrologers use detailed methods giving relief for exaltation, own sign etc.; we use only the basic method and say so openly. A low match is not a final verdict; the right way is for both families to talk openly and show the full horoscopes to an experienced astrologer. The remedies we suggest are no-cost only.
copy.kundali.intro.2.heading: 36 gunas and Chovva dosham
copy.kundali.intro.2.paras.0: For comparison, the North Indian 36-guna Ashtakoota matching and the Chovva dosham check (houses 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 from Lagna and Moon) are given below the result. Tradition says if both have Chovva dosham it cancels out.
copy.kundali.faq.0.q: How many poruthams are needed for marriage?
copy.kundali.faq.0.a: Generally six or more of ten, including Rajju and Dina, is good; above eight is excellent. Papasamyam and Chovva dosham should also be checked.
copy.kundali.faq.1.q: Without Papasamyam, should the marriage not happen?
copy.kundali.faq.1.a: Not so. If the girl's papa is higher, treat it only as one factor to note. Detailed methods may give relief; decide after showing the full horoscopes to an experienced astrologer.
copy.kundali.faq.2.a: If both nakshatras fall in the same rajju there is no Rajju porutham. Tamil method: five rajjus (pada, kati, nabhi, kanta, siras); Kerala method: three (pada, kati, nabhi) — same kati rajju does not agree, same pada or nabhi is partial. Tradition gives this great importance, but it is not a verdict to fear — something to consider more carefully.
copy.kundali.faq.3.q: What is the ½ point in the Kerala method?
copy.kundali.faq.3.a: In Kerala Dashakoota, Gana, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rajju and Rasi can agree fully or partially; partial gives ½ point. Example: both nakshatras in the same pada or nabhi rajju = ½ for Rajju; in kati rajju = 0. So a Kerala total can be like 7.5 / 10.
copy.kundali.faq.4.q: What is the difference between ten poruthams and 36 gunas?
copy.kundali.faq.4.a: 36-guna Ashtakoota is the North Indian method giving guna points to eight kootas. Ten poruthams are checked in Kerala and Tamil Nadu; Rajju, Vedha, Mahendra and Stree Deergha are only in this. This page has both.
copy.kundali.faq.5.q: Can matching be done without knowing the birth time?
copy.kundali.faq.5.a: If the nakshatra is known, the ten poruthams can be checked to an extent. But Papasamyam needs the lagnam, which needs an exact birth time.
copy.kundali.faq.6.q: Why does the order of groom and bride matter?
copy.kundali.faq.6.a: Dina, Mahendra, Stree Deergha are counted from the girl's nakshatra; Papasamyam also compares each person's papa separately. So give the groom's details in the first column.

copy.remedies.Mars: Tuesday visit to a Subrahmanya temple, Skanda Shashti vratham (if you wish); controlling anger, patience while driving.
copy.remedies.Mercury: Wednesday chanting Vishnu Sahasranamam; honesty in speech and accounts.
copy.remedies.Jupiter: Thursday worship of Guruvayurappan or Dakshinamurthy, blessings of teachers; giving books to poor children.
copy.remedies.Venus: Friday Devi worship, keeping the home clean; respect towards women.
copy.remedies.Saturn: Saturday sesame-oil lamp, worship of Sastha or Hanuman; helping the elderly and hard-working people — Saturn's favourite remedy.
copy.remedies.Rahu: Durga worship, lamp at a sarpakkavu (if you wish); staying away from shortcuts.
copy.remedies.Ketu: Ganapathi worship, meditation; patiently finishing old matters.
copy.remedies.sadeSati: During Ezharasani: Saturday sesame-oil lamp, Sastha darshan or Hanuman Chalisa, helping the elderly, honesty at work. No fear or big expense needed.
copy.remedies.dhaiya: During Kandakasani / Ashtamasani: Saturday vratham (if you wish), giving sesame, Sastha worship, a regular routine.

copy.south.title: Ten poruthams — nakshatra matching
copy.south.lead: The ten poruthams checked before marriage in Kerala, computed from both people's birth nakshatra and koor. Those marked ★ are the main poruthams.
copy.south.what.dina: Wellbeing and harmony of both in daily life. Counted from the girl's nakshatra to the boy's, checking whether the count is an auspicious number.
copy.south.what.gana: Nature and temperament — whether Deva, Manushya, Asura ganas match.
copy.south.what.mahendra: Family growth, children, prosperity. Agrees if the boy's nakshatra is 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25 from the girl's.
copy.south.what.stree-deergha: Wife's wellbeing and family prosperity. The boy's nakshatra should be more than 9 away from the girl's.
copy.south.what.yoni: Natural closeness and attraction between the two — checks whether the nakshatras' yoni animals are enemies.
copy.south.what.rasi: The relation between the two koors. If the boy's koor is 2, 6, 8, 12 from the girl's it is counted as a dosha; 7 is best.
copy.south.what.rasyadhipathi: Whether the two sign lords are friends or neutral — a sign of mental compatibility.
copy.south.what.vasya: Mutual attraction and affection — by the traditional vasya-rasi table.
copy.south.what.rajju: Strength of the marriage bond — by tradition the most important of the ten. The two nakshatras should not be in the same rajju (pada, kati, nabhi, kanta, siras).
copy.south.what.vedha: Not being a nakshatra pair with mutual vedha (e.g. Ashwathi–Thrikketta).
copy.south.countNote(): {1} of ten poruthams agree. Rajju and Dina agree — by tradition these are the foundation. Generally six or more of ten, with Rajju and Dina, counts as a good match. (one of two variants)
copy.south.method: Computed from both people's Moon nakshatra and koor (Lahiri). Dina, Mahendra, Stree Deergha are counted from the girl's nakshatra, so give the groom's details in the first column. This is the Tamil/South-Indian table; choose 'Kerala method' above for the Kerala result.
copy.south.kerala.title: Ten poruthams — Kerala method
copy.south.kerala.lead: By Kerala Dashakoota, from both people's birth nakshatra and koor. In this method some poruthams also get half (½) a point; total out of 10.
copy.south.kerala.total(): Total {1} / 10 points. This is only guidance; before deciding, show both full horoscopes to an experienced astrologer.
copy.south.kerala.what.dina: Counting from the girl's nakshatra to the boy's, everything is auspicious except positions 3, 5, 7 in each group of nine (Vipat, Pratyak, Vadha taras). The same nakshatra also agrees.
copy.south.kerala.what.gana: Deva–Deva, Manushya–Manushya, Asura–Asura, Manushya-gana girl with Deva-gana boy: full. Manushya-gana girl with Asura-gana boy: partial. Others: none.
copy.south.kerala.what.stree-deergha: If the boy's nakshatra is 19 or more from the girl's: full; 10 to 18: partial; up to 9: none.
copy.south.kerala.what.yoni: Female/male nature of the nakshatras: girl's a female star and boy's a male star = full; both female = partial; others none.
copy.south.kerala.what.rasi: If the boy's koor is 2 to 6 from the girl's: none; 8: partial; 1, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12: full.
copy.south.kerala.what.rasyadhipathi: Whether the lords of the two koors agree — by the Kerala porutham table.
copy.south.kerala.what.vasya: Mutual attraction and affection — whether one koor is vasya to the other (Kerala table).
copy.south.kerala.what.rajju: Kerala method has three rajjus — pada, kati (middle), nabhi. Both in kati rajju: none; both in pada or nabhi rajju: partial; different rajjus: full.
copy.south.kerala.method: Kerala Dashakoota method, Lahiri ayanamsa. Checked against ProKerala's Kerala jathaka porutham calculator on 235 pairs; the result was the same for every porutham. Some astrologers calculate with small differences.
copy.south.papa.title: Papasamyam
copy.south.papa.lead: Counts, in both horoscopes, the malefics Mars, Saturn, Sun, Rahu in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12 from Lagna, Moon and Venus, and checks whether the dosha is balanced on both sides. The rule: the girl's papa should not exceed the boy's.
copy.south.papa.balanced: Papasamyam exists — the girl's papa is not more than the boy's.
copy.south.papa.unbalanced: Papasamyam is low — the girl's papa is more than the boy's. No need to decide on this alone; consider it with Chovva dosham and the other poruthams together with an experienced astrologer.
copy.south.papa.method: Count: each malefic 1 from Lagna, ½ from Moon, ¼ from Venus. Some astrologers add reliefs by the planet's exaltation, own sign or house; those are not included here, so the number can differ slightly.

copy.kundaliText.kootaLead: What each of the eight kootas checks:
copy.kundaliText.samePerson: Both people's details are the same — please check.
copy.kundaliText.minor: One person is not yet 18. This is for information only.
copy.kundaliText.totalNote(): {1} of 36 — below 18. This is not a final verdict; talk it over after looking at the full horoscopes. (one variant)
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.varna: How well the two people's outlook and view of life match (1 guna).
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.tara: Dina matching between the nakshatras — health and wellbeing (3 gunas).
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.graha_maitri: Whether the two sign lords are friends — mental compatibility (5 gunas).
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.gana: Deva, Manushya, Asura gana — match of nature (6 gunas).
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.bhakoot: Distance between the two koors — family wellbeing and financial harmony (7 gunas).
copy.kundaliText.kootaWhat.nadi: Adi, Madhya, Antya nadi — children and health compatibility (8 gunas, the most).
copy.kundaliText.dosha(): The two ganas don't match; but a classical exception applies, so this is not treated as a concern. (one variant)
copy.kundaliText.manglikStatus.clear: Neither horoscope has Chovva dosham — not an issue at all in this match.
copy.kundaliText.manglikStatus.mutual: Both have Chovva dosham. Tradition says when both have it the dosha balances out — no worry.
copy.kundaliText.manglikStatus.cancelled: One person has Chovva dosham, but a classical exception applies; so it is not a concern.
copy.kundaliText.manglikStatus.one-sided: Only one person has Chovva dosham and no exception applies. Tradition says to note it — calmly, not as an obstacle. Simple remedies are below.
copy.kundaliText.manglikLine(): {1}: has Chovva dosham (stronger) — Mars in the {4}th house from Lagna (counts); {6}th house from the Moon (counts). (sample)
copy.kundaliText.remedies.nadi: For Nadi dosha: before marriage both chant the Mrityunjaya mantra or Vishnu Sahasranamam together; annadanam (giving food) if you wish.
copy.kundaliText.remedies.bhakoot: For Rasi dosha: both families talk openly about money and responsibilities; light a lamp and pray on the days of both sign lords.
copy.kundaliText.remedies.gana: For Gana dosha: give time to understand each other's nature; remember the Guru on Thursdays.
copy.kundaliText.remedies.manglik: For Chovva dosham: Tuesday visit to a Subrahmanya temple; controlling anger. No need for the expense of big poojas.
copy.kundaliText.remedies.general: No remedy is compulsory, nothing is guaranteed. BornClock sells nothing. Before a big decision, show both full horoscopes to an experienced astrologer.
copy.kundaliText.answer: Enter the groom's and bride's birth date, time and place — the ten poruthams one by one, Papasamyam, Chovva dosham, 36-guna matching, simple remedies — all in Malayalam, free.
